name: Star Blue
extraCss: .window{grid-template-rows:24px 28px minmax(0,1fr) 24px;padding:0;background:#000;border:2px solid #c0c0c0;box-shadow:none}.titlebar{background:#c0c0c0;color:#000;font-weight:700;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid #000;padding:1px 4px}.icon{display:none}.caption{background:#c0c0c0;box-shadow:none;border:1px solid #000}.menubar{height:28px;align-items:center;background:#c0c0c0;color:#000;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid #000;box-shadow:none;padding:0 3px;font-weight:700;overflow:visible;z-index:20}.menuwrap{z-index:21}.menubtn{font-weight:700;color:#000;box-shadow:none;padding:3px 6px}.menubtn:hover,.menubtn.open{border-color:transparent;background:#000;color:#fff;box-shadow:none}.menu{top:25px;background:#c0c0c0;color:#000;border:1px solid #000;box-shadow:none;z-index:50}.item{font-weight:700}.item:hover{background:#000;color:#fff}.sep{border-top-color:#808080;border-bottom-color:#fff}.editorframe{background:#000;box-shadow:none;padding:0;margin:0;border:0}textarea{padding:4px 5px;font-size:15px;line-height:1.32;letter-spacing:.1px}textarea::selection,textarea:focus::selection{background-color:#d8d8d8!important;color:#000!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#000!important;text-shadow:none!important}.status{background:#c0c0c0;color:#000;box-shadow:none;border:0;border-top:1px solid #000;margin:0;padding:0 5px;font-weight:700}.grip{background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,transparent 0 3px,#000 3px 5px)}.aboutbox{background:#c0c0c0;color:#000;border:2px solid #000;box-shadow:none;padding:0}.abouttitle{background:#c0c0c0;color:#000;border-bottom:1px solid #000}.aboutbody{background:#000;color:#fff}.winbutton{background:#c0c0c0;color:#000!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#000!important;border:1px solid #000;box-shadow:none;font-weight:700}
